title: Remote sandboxes
description: Cloud sandboxes this desktop can run project agents in, created when a run needs one: E2B, or a Kubernetes cluster you connect.
failed: The remote sandbox settings could not be read.

availability.active: Remote sandboxes are on. Runs that ask for a runtime environment can be placed on the providers below.
availability.noProviders: No provider is configured, so every run stays on this desktop.
availability.bundleUnpinned: This build ships no pinned agent bundle, so it cannot put an agent into a remote sandbox. Providers saved here are kept, and nothing runs remotely until a build that ships one.

restart.title: Restart Cognia to apply
restart.body: Saved changes take effect the next time the app starts. Sandboxes already running keep the settings they started with.

installError.title: Remote sandboxes did not start
installError.body: The settings saved before this start were refused: {error}

providers.title: Providers
providers.limits: Up to {concurrent} at once · {lifetime} min lifetime · idle after {idle} min
providers.defaultHint: Runs set to “auto” use this desktop's own sandbox when it can, else the default provider.

live.reachable: Running: reachable, {instances, plural, =1 {# sandbox} other {# sandboxes}} and {sessions, plural, =1 {# session} other {# sessions}} in use
live.notRunning: Not running in this session; it starts with the app next time.
live.unreadable: The running pool's status could not be read.

removeDialog.title: Remove {label}?
removeDialog.body: Its stored credential is deleted too. Projects that name this provider are refused until they pick another. Sandboxes already running are not stopped.

editor.description: Saved to this desktop. Credentials go to the system's secret store and are never shown again.
editor.idHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, up to 32. Projects name the provider by it.
editor.label: Name

credential.keep: A credential is stored. Leave this empty to keep it.
credential.keepSource: The credential is read from {source}. Type one to store it here instead.

editor.maxLifetimeHint: Every sandbox is destroyed at this age, whatever it is doing.
editor.idleTimeoutHint: A persistent sandbox with no session is destroyed after this.

e2b.delegatedRegistries: Registries E2B may pull from with your credentials
e2b.delegatedRegistriesHint: One registry host per line. E2B builds templates on its own servers, so a private image's pull credential is handed to it only for the registries listed here; any other private image is refused.

kubernetes.connectionInClusterHint: Only when Cognia itself runs as a Pod in that cluster.
kubernetes.runtimeClassesHint: gVisor and VM tiers are offered only when mapped and present in the cluster.

egressHint.none: Nothing restricts egress: every network setting is recorded, not enforced.
egressHint.network-policy: No-network runs are enforced. An allowlist is recorded but not enforced: NetworkPolicy cannot match host names.
egressHint.cilium: No-network runs and allowlists are both enforced.

problem.id_invalid: Use 1–32 lowercase letters, digits or dashes, starting with a letter or digit, and not “local”.
problem.id_taken: Another provider already uses this ID.
problem.out_of_range: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
problem.url_invalid: Use an https URL with no credentials, query or fragment (http only on localhost).
problem.domain_invalid: Enter a DNS name, such as e2b.app.
problem.template_prefix_invalid: Use 1–32 lowercase letters, digits, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or digit.
problem.namespace_invalid: Use a DNS label: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, up to 63.
problem.name_invalid: Use a DNS name: lowercase letters, digits, dashes and dots.

registries.title: Allowed image registries
registries.description: Projects may only run images from these registries. A prefix narrows a registry to the repositories under it.
registries.empty: No registries are allowed, so only the built-in images can run.

problem.registry_invalid: Enter a registry host such as ghcr.io or localhost:5000.
problem.duplicate: This registry and prefix are listed twice.

errors.remote_sandboxes_unwritable: The settings could not be written: {message}
errors.remote_sandboxes_unreadable: The settings could not be read: {message}
errors.remote_sandboxes_version_unsupported: These settings were written by a newer Cognia: {message}
errors.remote_sandboxes_secret_unwritable: The credential could not be stored: {message}
errors.remote_sandboxes_secret_unreferenced: A credential no provider uses was refused: {message}
